items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: It was a little friend of mine came by and saw a bunch of nickels

ctx.x: Only one time. I told her about that. I got a spanking about some money which she thought I had
taken, which I didn't. It was a little friend of mine came by and saw a bunch of nickels under the counter on the -- in the kitchen.
